ERROR:  relation "pages" does not exist
LINE 1: ...projekt_phases pp on pp.projekt_id=p.id left join pages pg o...
                                                             ^
=== pages table cols ===
landing_page_id

observation.command: cd /workspace && PGPASSWORD=root psql -U root -h localhost -d consul_development -tAc "select p.id,p.name,pg.slug from projekts p join projekt_phases pp on pp.projekt_id=p.id left join pages pg on pg.id=p.page_id where pp.type='ProjektPhase::ProposalPhase' limit 5;" 2>&1; echo "=== pages table cols ==="; PGPASSWORD=root psql -U root -h localhost -d consul_development -tAc "select column_name from information_schema.columns where table_name='projekts' and column_name like '%page%';"
